get_cart.code:
response = client.carts.get_cart("cart-7f3a9c2e1b")
cart = response.map["cart"]
for item in cart["items"]:
    print(item["id"], item["product"]["sku"], item["quantity"], item["pricing"]["total"])
totals = cart["totals"]
print(totals["subtotal"], totals["tax"], totals["grand_total"])
print(cart["shipping"]["shipping_tax"], cart["shipping"]["handling_tax"])

create_order_from_cart.code:
response = client.carts.create_order_from_cart("cart-7f3a9c2e1b", {
    "customer_id": 123,
    "payment_gateway": "PIS",
    "delivery_type": "shipping",
    "transaction_no": "web-order-0001",
})
order = response.map["order"]
print(response.map["status"], order["order_id"], order["order_no"])
print(order["order_status"], order["payment_status"], order["grand_total"], order["due"])
for line in order["order_line_details"]:
    print(line["sku"], line["quantity"], line["total_amount"])
